digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport retry layer
propositions: A Jira Data Center 429 rate-limit response propagates as a hard failure because _with_connection_retry does not retry HTTP errors.
The fix honours the Retry-After header when present plus up to 20% jitter, clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S, and degrades gracefully when the header is absent.
Retry is scoped to idempotent reads via a per-call rate_limit_retry flag defaulting to OFF, so mutations never retry a 429 and cannot reintroduce duplicate writes.
The opt-in flag must reach the retry layer through two distinct paths: via _call_logged/_paged_search and via get_comment_map's direct per-issue _with_connection_retry call.
On cap exhaustion the adapter raises BackendHTTPError with code 429 and never leaks the vendor JIRAError past the boundary.

Retry-After is read from exc.response.headers rather than exc.headers, and the researched DC facts (DC-only, 8.6+, off-by-default, retry-after+20% jitter) are each confirmed or explicitly marked unverified.
